The backend URLs your project's events are sent to: create and change them, test them, and see and
retry their deliveries.

Usage:
  voidhash webhook <command> [flags]

Aliases:
  webhook, webhooks

Commands:
  list        List the project's webhooks and whether they deliver.
  view        Show a webhook: its URL, events and health, and its latest deliveries with how it
              answered.
  create      Create a webhook and print its signing secret, shown only this once.
  edit        Change a webhook's name, URL, events, description or environment.
  enable      Turn a webhook on again, also one Voidhash stopped after repeated failures.
  disable     Stop sending events to a webhook without deleting it.
  delete      Delete a webhook and its delivery history.
  rotate      Replace a webhook's signing secret and print the new one, shown only this once.
  test        Send a signed test event to a webhook and show how it answered.
  deliveries  List deliveries, newest first, across webhooks or of one, with how the webhook
              answered.
  delivery    Show one delivery with every attempt and how the webhook answered each.
  retry       Send failed deliveries again now and show how the webhook answered.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash webhook <command> --help' for more about a command.
